sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: Use familiar forms together in short, meaningful exchanges.

items.english: He's not an acquaintance, he's a friend.

sections.content: Van egy testvérem. leans on the Hungarian 'have' construction from earlier units, and Ő nem ismerős, ő barát. leans on the copula-drop identity rule from Grammar 1 — say who someone isn't, then who they are, both without van. Stringing the two together is exactly how you'd correct someone's assumption about a person you're introducing.
